description: This file contains C source code implementing memory management unit (MMU) setup, specifically for setting up TLB entries on a PowerPC architecture. It defines the function 'MM_TlbSetup' which configures TLB entries based on a provided table.

methods.name: void MM_TlbSetup(const struct TlbEntry * tblTable)
methods.description: Sets up TLB entries based on a provided table of entries, configuring PowerPC special purpose registers accordingly.
